Lawyer Bob Amsterdam has represented exiled clients against authoritarian governments for decades, and more recently the Ukrainian Orthodox Church against Kyiv. With Tucker Carlson, he argues that the American aid agency USAID helps President Zelensky destroy Christianity in Ukraine using fake churches and violence, as the episode frames it.

Amsterdam presents cases of seized churches and prosecuted clergy as a persecution campaign funded from Washington. Kyiv answers that the targeted church answers to Moscow and shelters its war. Both framings cannot be wholly right, and the episode gives only Amsterdam's, at length, as advocacy. It is preserved because the church war inside Ukraine's war deserves a hearing in its dissenting form. Listeners can weigh a veteran human rights lawyer's brief against the security case he opposes.
